description.value: Sushi Shun is a Japanese sushi restaurant in a strip-mall unit in Surrey's Clayton neighbourhood, serving the Lower Mainland. The restaurant offers online ordering through its website and a dedicated app with a points-and-rewards program, letting cyclists pre-order before arriving. It is a sit-down option for a hot meal after a ride through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website corroborates the OSM name, address, and phone number exactly. The website explicitly advertises online ordering ('Sushi Shun is now taking online orders. Order through our website or download our app'), confirming takeout capability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content, so those fields are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible sushi restaurant with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. A useful meal stop for touring cyclists in the Surrey/Clayton area.
